create_async_bedrock_file: create an async file for batch completion using litellm acreate_file with bedrock provider and s3 bucket
create_async_bedrock_batch: create an async batch request using litellm acreate_batch with bedrock provider, model, and aws role arn
retrieve_async_bedrock_batch: retrieve an async batch response using litellm aretrieve_batch with bedrock provider and batch id
test_bedrock_file_url_mapping: test the bedrock file url to s3 uri mapping using BedrockFilesConfig conversion method
test_bedrock_batch_encryption_key: test that s3 encryption key id is included in the bedrock batch creation post request payload
